opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or who have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality. Aims to secure temporary postdoctoral or PhD placements.
opportunities.summary: A rescue mission for academics in immediate danger, providing temporary refuge in universities and research institutions (mostly in the UK) where they can continue their work. Provides 2- or 3-year awards as standard, helping with placements, additional funding, visas and practical arrangements. Applications are considered on a rolling basis.
